get_historical_reservations.title: Retrieve historical reservations
get_historical_reservations.description: Retrieve historical reservations. Retrieve eligible room reservations whose check-in dates fall within the inclusive requested range, grouped by property reservation. Both check_in_start and check_in_end are required in YYYY-MM-DD format, without a time or timezone suffix. The bounds must satisfy today (UTC) minus 24 calendar months <= check_in_start <= check_in_end <= today (UTC). Equal bounds select a single check-in day; today is allowed. Reservation creation and check-out dates do not restrict this range.

property_id.description: Booking.com property ID for a property your connection is authorized to access for reservation history.

check_in_start.description: Inclusive check-in lower bound in YYYY-MM-DD format, without a time or timezone suffix. Must be on or after today (UTC) minus 24 calendar months and no later than check_in_end. Both bounds are required and have no defaults. Calendar subtraction adjusts a leap day to the final valid day of February. Choose dates within the current eligibility window; fixed examples eventually expire.

check_in_end.description: Inclusive check-in upper bound in YYYY-MM-DD format, without a time or timezone suffix. Must be on or after check_in_start and no later than today (UTC). Today is allowed. Equal bounds select a single check-in day. Format: date.

status.description: Room reservation statuses to include. Omit this parameter to include all supported statuses. An empty `status` value returns HTTP `400`. Repeat the query parameter to select multiple values. For example, an HTTP request can use `status=OK&status=NO_SHOW`. In Try it, enter individual status values as separate items. Only matching rooms remain in each property reservation.

accept_version.description: API version. Send `1.0`. This is also the default when the header is omitted.

output.description: Historical reservations matching the request. The response has no pagination parameters or continuation token.

data.description: Reservation data for the requested property. Optional values are omitted when unavailable, rather than returned as null. Fields: property_id, currency, property_reservations.

meta.description: Metadata for support and request tracing. Fields: ruid.
